summary: Pestilent ghosts pick at portraits dangling in precarious plaster. Unpainted pasts, hang on bent nails in our walls pealing as time forgets stories all remember. Logic dismembered dripping in dark sunshine only hidden truths unleash #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Pestilent ghosts
pick at portraits
dangling in precarious
plaster.
Unpainted pasts, hang on
bent
nails in our walls

pealing as time
forgets stories
all remember.
Logic dismembered
dripping in dark
sunshine only hidden
truths unleash
#smallpoems
